CREATE TABLE loop_items (
    id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
    resource_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
    project_space VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', 
    cloud_project_id VARCHAR(64), 
    parent_id VARCHAR(64), 
    loop_item_id VARCHAR(64), 
    delivery_id VARCHAR(64), 
    public_id VARCHAR(36), 
    project_key VARCHAR(16), 
    name VARCHAR(255), 
    title VARCHAR(255), 
    description TEXT NOT NULL, 
    storage_prefix VARCHAR(512), 
    sequence_number INTEGER, 
    next_item_number INTEGER, 
    created_by_user_id INTEGER, 
    updated_by_user_id INTEGER, 
    assignee_user_id INTEGER, 
    user_id INTEGER, 
    added_by_user_id INTEGER, 
    source VARCHAR(20), 
    status VARCHAR(32), 
    priority VARCHAR(20), 
    due_at DATETIME, 
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
    current_delivery_id VARCHAR(64), 
    local_project_id INTEGER, 
    device_id VARCHAR(100), 
    is_default BOOL, 
    task_user_id INTEGER, 
    task_id VARCHAR(255), 
    task_title VARCHAR(255), 
    backend_task_id BIGINT, 
    linked_by_user_id INTEGER, 
    linked_at DATETIME, 
    unlinked_at DATETIME, 
    path VARCHAR(700), 
    kind VARCHAR(32), 
    display_name VARCHAR(255), 
    relative_path VARCHAR(700), 
    object_key VARCHAR(1400), 
    content_type VARCHAR(255), 
    size_bytes BIGINT, 
    sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
    source_task_binding_id VARCHAR(64), 
    source_task_snapshot JSON, 
    markdown_object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
    chat_object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
    manifest_object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
    metadata JSON, 
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    completed_at DATETIME, 
    delivered_at DATETIME, 
    PRIMARY KEY (id), 
    FOREIGN KEY(cloud_project_id) REFERENCES loop_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
    FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES loop_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
    FOREIGN KEY(loop_item_id) REFERENCES loop_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
    FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES loop_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
    FOREIGN KEY(local_project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
    FOREIGN KEY(backend_task_id) REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
    UNIQUE (public_id), 
    UNIQUE (project_key), 
    UNIQUE (storage_prefix)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX idx_loop_items_project_type ON loop_items (cloud_project_id, resource_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_loop_items_parent_type ON loop_items (parent_id, resource_type, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_loop_items_project_path ON loop_items (cloud_project_id, path)
